# Generated presidential-history effects: edit this generator, then regenerate the output.
# Archive variables are durable country state; recent/display variables are copies for the library UI.

# National History (Workshop 3772525185) is the architectural reference only.
# BPR owns its append-only archive, latest-50 cache, GUI, and vptl_ namespace.

vptl_capture_presidential_history_power_rank = {
	set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = -1 }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:decentralized_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:unrecognized_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:insignificant_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:unrecognized_regional_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:minor_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:unrecognized_major_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:major_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { country_rank = rank_value:great_power } set_variable = { name = vptl_history_capture_rank value = 7 } }
}

			else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_current_slot = 121 has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_121_populated NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_121_closed } } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_121_score_rank_end value = var:vptl_history_capture_score_rank } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_current_slot = 122 has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_122_populated NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_122_closed } } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_122_score_rank_end value = var:vptl_history_capture_score_rank } }

			else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_current_slot = 125 has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_125_populated NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_125_closed } } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_125_score_rank_end value = var:vptl_history_capture_score_rank } }

			set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_rank_latched
		}
	}
}

vptl_prepare_presidential_history_episode_number = {
	# The normal accession path owns the first assignment. The ledger accepts it.
	# Only a former president returning with an older number is advanced here.
	vptl_assign_presidential_order_number_to_current_ruler = yes
	ruler ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_numbered_ruler }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_order_counter } scope:vptl_history_numbered_ruler ?= { has_variable = vptl_presidential_order_number } }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_order_counter value = scope:vptl_history_numbered_ruler.var:vptl_presidential_order_number }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_previous_president has_variable = vptl_presidential_order_counter scope:vptl_history_numbered_ruler ?= { is_character_alive = yes has_variable = vptl_presidential_order_number NOT = { owner.var:vptl_presidential_history_previous_president ?= this } } }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_number_gap value = var:vptl_presidential_order_counter }
		change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_number_gap subtract = scope:vptl_history_numbered_ruler.var:vptl_presidential_order_number }
		if = {
			limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_number_gap > 0 }
			change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_order_counter add = 1 }
			scope:vptl_history_numbered_ruler = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_order_number value = owner.var:vptl_presidential_order_counter } vptl_refresh_presidential_office_markers = yes }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_number_gap < 0 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_order_counter value = scope:vptl_history_numbered_ruler.var:vptl_presidential_order_number } }
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_number_gap
	}
}

vptl_freeze_presidential_history_affiliations_for_record = {
	# Legacy records derive each broad category once from their still-valid scope.
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity } }
		set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = agrarian_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = anarchist_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = communist_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = conservative_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = fascist_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = free_trade_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = liberal_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = military_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 8 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = radical_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 9 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = religious_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = revolutionary_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 11 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_party ?= { is_party_type = social_democrat_party } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_party_type_identity value = 12 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity } }
		set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_devout } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_ig ?= { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ig_type_identity value = 8 } }
	}
}

vptl_freeze_presidential_history_profile_for_record = {
	# Backfill old records once, and only while their original president resolves.
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated var:$PREFIX$_president ?= { is_character_alive = yes } OR = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_culture } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_religion } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_ideology } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity_start } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity } } }
		var:$PREFIX$_president ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_profile_subject culture ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_capture_culture } religion ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_capture_religion } ideology ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_capture_ideology } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_culture } exists = scope:vptl_history_capture_culture } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_culture value = scope:vptl_history_capture_culture } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_religion } exists = scope:vptl_history_capture_religion } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_religion value = scope:vptl_history_capture_religion } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_ideology } exists = scope:vptl_history_capture_ideology } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ideology value = scope:vptl_history_capture_ideology } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity } }
			set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jacksonian_democrat } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity value = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_ideology_identity value = 5 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity_start } has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_popularity_start value = var:$PREFIX$_popularity } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity_start } exists = scope:vptl_history_profile_subject } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_popularity_start value = scope:vptl_history_profile_subject.popularity } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity } has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity_start } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_popularity value = var:$PREFIX$_popularity_start } }
	}
	remove_variable = vptl_history_capture_culture
	remove_variable = vptl_history_capture_religion
	remove_variable = vptl_history_capture_ideology
}

vptl_freeze_presidential_history_vice_president_profile_for_record = {
	# Legacy VP profiles are backfilled only from the exact stored deputy.
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated var:$PREFIX$_vice_president ?= { is_character_alive = yes } OR = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_culture } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_religion } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_start } NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity } } }
		var:$PREFIX$_vice_president ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_vice_president_profile_subject culture ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_capture_vice_president_culture } religion ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_capture_vice_president_religion } ideology ?= { save_scope_as = vptl_history_capture_vice_president_ideology } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_culture } exists = scope:vptl_history_capture_vice_president_culture } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_culture value = scope:vptl_history_capture_vice_president_culture } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_religion } exists = scope:vptl_history_capture_vice_president_religion } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_religion value = scope:vptl_history_capture_vice_president_religion } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology } exists = scope:vptl_history_capture_vice_president_ideology } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology value = scope:vptl_history_capture_vice_president_ideology } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity } }
			set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_vice_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jacksonian_democrat } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_vice_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_vice_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity value = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_vice_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { var:$PREFIX$_vice_president ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate } } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_ideology_identity value = 5 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_start } exists = scope:vptl_history_vice_president_profile_subject } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_start value = scope:vptl_history_vice_president_profile_subject.popularity } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity } has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_start } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity value = var:$PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_start } }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated has_variable = $PREFIX$_closed NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_end } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_end value = var:$PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_start } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_end value = var:$PREFIX$_vice_president_popularity_start } }
	}
	remove_variable = vptl_history_capture_vice_president_culture
	remove_variable = vptl_history_capture_vice_president_religion
	remove_variable = vptl_history_capture_vice_president_ideology
	remove_variable = vptl_history_vice_president_profile_subject
}

vptl_migrate_presidential_history_metric_snapshots_for_record = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_closed } }
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_end
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_population_end
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_end
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_end
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_rank_end
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_score_rank_end
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity_end
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_change_percent
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_population_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_population_change_percent
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_change_percent
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_change_percent
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_active_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_active_change_percent
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_population_active_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_population_active_change_percent
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_active_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_active_change_percent
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_active_change_available
		remove_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_active_change_percent
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated has_variable = $PREFIX$_closed NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity_end } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_popularity_end value = var:$PREFIX$_popularity } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_popularity_start } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_popularity_end value = var:$PREFIX$_popularity_start } }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_populated has_variable = $PREFIX$_closed NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_score_rank_end } has_variable = $PREFIX$_score_rank_start $PREFIX$_score_rank_start > 0 } set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_score_rank_end value = var:$PREFIX$_score_rank_start } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_start has_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_end $PREFIX$_gdp_start > 0 NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_change_available } }
		set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_gdp_change_percent value = 0 }
		change_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_gdp_change_percent add = { value = var:$PREFIX$_gdp_end subtract = var:$PREFIX$_gdp_start divide = var:$PREFIX$_gdp_start multiply = 100 } }
		set_variable = $PREFIX$_gdp_change_available
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_population_start has_variable = $PREFIX$_population_end $PREFIX$_population_start > 0 NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_population_change_available } }
		set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_population_change_percent value = 0 }
		change_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_population_change_percent add = { value = var:$PREFIX$_population_end subtract = var:$PREFIX$_population_start divide = var:$PREFIX$_population_start multiply = 100 } }
		set_variable = $PREFIX$_population_change_available
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_start has_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_end $PREFIX$_sol_start > 0 NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_change_available } }
		set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_sol_change_percent value = 0 }
		change_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_sol_change_percent add = { value = var:$PREFIX$_sol_end subtract = var:$PREFIX$_sol_start divide = var:$PREFIX$_sol_start multiply = 100 } }
		set_variable = $PREFIX$_sol_change_available
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_start has_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_end $PREFIX$_prestige_start > 0 NOT = { has_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_change_available } }
		set_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_prestige_change_percent value = 0 }
		change_variable = { name = $PREFIX$_prestige_change_percent add = { value = var:$PREFIX$_prestige_end subtract = var:$PREFIX$_prestige_start divide = var:$PREFIX$_prestige_start multiply = 100 } }
		set_variable = $PREFIX$_prestige_change_available
	}
}

vptl_finalize_presidential_history_archive_slot = {
	if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_current_slot = $SLOT$ has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_populated NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_closed } }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_end value = gdp }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_end value = total_population }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_end value = average_sol }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_end value = prestige }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_rank_end value = var:vptl_history_capture_rank }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_score_rank_end } var:vptl_history_capture_score_rank > 0 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_score_rank_end value = var:vptl_history_capture_score_rank } }
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_change_percent
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_start has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_end vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_start > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_change_percent value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_change_percent add = { value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_end subtract = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_start divide = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_start multiply = 100 } }
			set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_change_available
		}
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_change_percent
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_start has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_end vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_start > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_change_percent value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_change_percent add = { value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_end subtract = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_start divide = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_start multiply = 100 } }
			set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_change_available
		}
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_change_percent
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_start has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_end vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_start > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_change_percent value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_change_percent add = { value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_end subtract = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_start divide = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_start multiply = 100 } }
			set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_change_available
		}
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_change_percent
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_start has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_end vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_start > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_change_percent value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_change_percent add = { value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_end subtract = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_start divide = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_start multiply = 100 } }
			set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_change_available
		}
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_active_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_active_change_percent
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_active_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_active_change_percent
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_active_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_active_change_percent
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_active_change_available
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_active_change_percent
		# Prefer the outgoing president, then the maintained active value, then the accession baseline.
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_popularity_start }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_popularity } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_popularity } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_president var:vptl_presidential_history_current_president ?= { is_character_alive = yes } } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_current_president.popularity } }
		# The closing record owns the final VP value; later successor changes cannot replace it.
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity_start } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity_start } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president ?= { is_character_alive = yes } } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president.popularity } }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_departure_reason value = var:vptl_presidential_history_departure_reason }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_end_year value = var:vptl_history_capture_year }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_end_month value = var:vptl_history_capture_month }
		set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_closed remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_active
		# Mirror the finalized archive snapshot before the recent cache shifts the episode.
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_populated NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_closed } }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_gdp_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_end } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_population_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_end } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_sol_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_end } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_prestige_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_end }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_rank_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_rank_end } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_score_rank_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_score_rank_end }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_popularity_end }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity_end } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_popularity_end value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_vice_president_popularity_end } } else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_popularity_end }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_gdp_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_gdp_change_percent value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_gdp_change_percent } } else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_gdp_change_available remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_gdp_change_percent }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_population_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_population_change_percent value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_population_change_percent } } else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_population_change_available remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_population_change_percent }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_sol_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_sol_change_percent value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_sol_change_percent } } else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_sol_change_available remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_sol_change_percent }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_prestige_change_available } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_prestige_change_percent value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_prestige_change_percent } } else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_prestige_change_available remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_prestige_change_percent }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_departure_reason value = var:vptl_presidential_history_departure_reason } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_end_year value = var:vptl_history_capture_year } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_end_month value = var:vptl_history_capture_month } set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_closed
		}
	}
}

vptl_preserve_presidential_history_subjects_before_close = {
	# The ledger's exact stored subjects are authoritative, not a transition helper scope.
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_president }
		var:vptl_presidential_history_current_president ?= {
			if = { limit = { is_character_alive = yes NOT = { has_role = character_role_vptl_presidential_history_subject } } add_character_role = character_role_vptl_presidential_history_subject }
			if = { limit = { is_character_alive = yes NOT = { has_role = character_role_vptl_former_president } } add_character_role = character_role_vptl_former_president }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president }
		var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president ?= { if = { limit = { is_character_alive = yes NOT = { has_role = character_role_vptl_presidential_history_subject } } add_character_role = character_role_vptl_presidential_history_subject } }
	}
}

vptl_refresh_open_presidential_history_episode = {
	# Historical final metrics are immutable; active cards bind directly to current Country values.
	# Only the associated successor and its active profile may refresh while the episode stays open.
	if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_slot has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_president NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_close_in_progress } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_successor }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president value = var:vptl_presidential_successor }
			set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 0 }
			var:vptl_presidential_successor = {
				if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = is_andrew_jackson has_template = usa_andrew_jackson_template } } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 1 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = USA_winfield_scott } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 2 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = USA_john_calhoun } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 3 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = USA_daniel_webster } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 4 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = USA_henry_clay } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 5 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = mex_miguel_barragan_template } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 6 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = MEX_anastasio_bustamante } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 7 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = MEX_valentin_gomez_farias } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 8 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = MEX_antonio_lopez_de_santa_anna } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 9 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = BOL_Jose_Miguel_de_Velasco } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 10 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = BOL_Andres_de_Santa_Cruz } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 11 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_template = CHL_Jose_Joaquin_Prieto } owner = { set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_vice_president_identity value = 12 } } }

vptl_record_presidential_history_law_in_archive_slot = {
	if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_current_slot = $SLOT$ has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_active }
		change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_count value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count }
		if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 1 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_1 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_1 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 2 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_2 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_2 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 3 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_3 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_3 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 4 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_4 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_4 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 5 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_5 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_5 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 6 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_6 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_6 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 7 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_7 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_7 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_count = 8 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_8 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_8 value = var:vptl_presidential_history_pending_law } }
		else = { change_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_overflow_count add = 1 } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_recent_1_law_overflow_count value = var:vptl_presidential_history_slot_$SLOT$_law_overflow_count } }
	}
}

vptl_copy_presidential_history_recent_to_display_slot = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_populated }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_president } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_president value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_president } }
		else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_president }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_vice_president } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_vice_president value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_vice_president } }
		else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_vice_president }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_party } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_party value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_party } }
		else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_party }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_ig } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_ig value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_ig } }
		else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_ig }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_culture } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_culture value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_culture } }
		else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_culture }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_religion } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_religion value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_religion } }
		else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_religion }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_ideology } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_ideology value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_ideology } }
		else = { remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_ideology }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_vice_president_culture } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_display_$SLOT$_vice_president_culture value = var:vptl_presidential_history_recent_$SLOT$_vice_president_culture } }

vptl_sync_presidential_history_after_ruler_change = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_sync_in_progress } } set_variable = vptl_presidential_history_sync_in_progress
		if = { limit = { NOT = { vptl_presidential_transition_qualifies = yes } has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_slot } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_departure_reason value = 6 } vptl_request_close_presidential_history_episode = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { vptl_presidential_transition_qualifies = yes OR = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_committed_change has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_pending_constitutional_accession AND = { NOT = { in_election_campaign = yes } NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_election_transition } NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_election_settlement_in_progress } NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_inauguration_pending } NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_inauguration_in_progress } NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_handoff_in_progress } } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_slot OR = { NOT = { ruler ?= { is_character_alive = yes } } NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_president } ruler ?= { NOT = { owner.var:vptl_presidential_history_current_president ?= this } } } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_departure_reason } } set_variable = { name = vptl_presidential_history_departure_reason value = 5 } } vptl_request_close_presidential_history_episode = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_slot } ruler ?= { is_character_alive = yes } } vptl_open_presidential_history_episode = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = vptl_presidential_history_current_slot } remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_pending_constitutional_accession } }
		}
		vptl_refresh_open_presidential_history_episode = yes
		remove_variable = vptl_presidential_history_sync_in_progress
	}
}
